summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Inverse Vix Short-Term Futures ETN (VYLD) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in volatility alternatives. The fund allows you to place a bet on volatility decreasing in the near-term. The product is a passively managed exchange-traded note backed by JPMorgan Chase VYLD was launched on Mar 20, 2025 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.
